caption: An ancient monk trick for waking up calmly #wellness #usahealth #wellnessjourney #chinesemedicineworks #healthy
transcript: Press a warm cloth against your closed eyes each morning and watch what happens. My friend, most people wake and reach for their phone. But the eyes are still holding the whole night. Soak a small cloth in warm water, ring it gently. Close your eyes and press it over them. Just sit, two minutes, nothing else. The eyes sit closest to the nervous system. All night they carry your dreams, your memories, the weight of your mind still working. Warmth there tells the whole body gently that it is safe to let go now. The shoulders drop first, then the breath slows. Then the mind clears softly instead of being shocked awake by a screen. Try this tomorrow. Warm cloth. Two minutes, stillness. There is a second step that makes the calm last for hours. I put the full ritual in my book, linked in my bio.
